Historical Pattern L2: embedding similarity via sentence-transformers (all-MiniLM-L6-v2). HistoricalPatternConfig with method (exact_match/embedding_similarity/dual), similarity_threshold (0.75 default). Dual-path merges L1+L2 with incident dedup. Graceful fallback to L1 on ImportError. 12 L2 tests pass. BPI benchmark: L2 shows no delta on BPI (opaque category IDs), dual preserves L1 findings. Synthetic test confirms L1 miss + L2 catch on different-category/same-semantic incidents.

Risk Synthesis L2: LLM narrative for conditional/reject CRs. RiskSynthesisConfig (method, api_base, api_key, model, cost_ceiling_usd). CostTracker for token/cost accounting. Selective routing: approve CRs → template, conditional/reject → LLM if within budget. Graceful fallback on LLM error. render_cr_report_l2_md adds 'Risk Narrative (AI-generated)' section. 15 tests pass (all mocked). httpx for OpenAI-compatible API calls.

Evaluation harness: ran full BPI 2014 (373 CAB CRs, 50 windows, 11.6s). 100% task completion, 100% schema compliance, 100% incompleteness (expected), 373 reject (missing artifacts = blocker), 27 schedule overlaps, 9 HP L1 findings (L2=0, BPI limitation). eval-report.json + eval-report.md produced at output/eval/. 5 pytest tests pass. MVP thesis answered: L2 embeddings validated on synthetic data; BPI lacks semantic content.
